title: Web dashboard, new site and tickets overhaul
items: Added a web dashboard with Discord sign-in, per-server settings, module search and on/off switches
Dashboard can be switched on or off per server with the dashboard command, and globally by owners
Added an audit log of every change made from the dashboard
Rebuilt the website with a categorised command list, docs, changelog, team, terms and privacy pages
Tickets now support multiple panels (3 free, 10 premium) and multiple staff roles (10 free, 20 premium)
Added ticket forms, priorities, claiming, subjects, per-panel transcripts, auto-close and statistics
Ticket welcome messages now ping the opener and staff roles
Fixed a database default that failed on older SQLite versions
